Walkthrough: one service from pull request to production ​

This follows the api service of the shop repository, owned by acme on GitHub Container Registry, from a pull request to a release. <commit> stands for the full 40-character commit SHA, 3f2c…4e3f here, and the namespace is shop.

Pull request ​

Commit 3f2c…4e3f is pushed to a pull request branch. The build publishes a multi-platform image and a prerelease chart, both marked pr-:

sh
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/acme/shop" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.revision=3f2c…4e3f" \
  -t ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api:pr-3f2c…4e3f --push .

helm package devops/helm/charts/api --version 0.0.0-pr-3f2c…4e3f \
  --app-version pr-3f2c…4e3f
helm push api-0.0.0-pr-3f2c…4e3f.tgz oci://ghcr.io/acme/charts/shop

Helm appends the chart name, so the chart lands at ghcr.io/acme/charts/shop/api:0.0.0-pr-3f2c…4e3f.

Default branch ​

The pull request merges with a fast-forward, so main builds the same commit and publishes it without the pr- mark, as images/shop/api:3f2c…4e3f and charts/shop/api:0.0.0-sha-3f2c…4e3f, whose default image is that same commit. A squash or merge commit gets its own SHA and tags the same way. The pull request tags stay where they are and expire later.

Release ​

The git tag v1.4.0 is pushed on that commit. The image is not built again; the release adds the version to the image the default branch built, so the digest stays the same:

sh
crane tag ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api:3f2c…4e3f 1.4.0

The chart does not follow the image. Its version is the version in its Chart.yaml, 2.1.0 here, which changed because the chart did, and a chart release is cut when the chart changes, not when the image does. Its appVersion and image tag default are set to 1.4.0 in that change, so the chart deploys this release unless a user overrides the image. It is pushed as charts/shop/api:2.1.0. Helm requires the tag to equal the chart version, so the commit is read from its org.opencontainers.image.revision annotation. An image release that leaves the chart as it is, such as 1.4.1, publishes no chart.

With docker/metadata-action, the same tag names come from:

yaml
- uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
  with:
    images: ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api
    tags: |
      type=semver,pattern={{version}}
      type=sha,format=long,prefix=

Deployment ​

A deployment pins the release by tag and digest:

yaml
image: ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api:1.4.0@sha256:9b1e…

The cluster pulls the digest. A reader sees the release, and crane ls ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api lists 3f2c…4e3f next to 1.4.0, which leads back to the commit in git.

Variant ​

A debug build of the same release is images/shop/api:1.4.0-debug, a suffix on the tag rather than another image name.

Moving tags for images others pull ​

If api were an open source image, the release would also move these tags:

sh
crane tag ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api:1.4.0 latest
crane tag ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api:1.4.0 1.x

An image only we deploy never gets them.

Wasm component ​

The WIT package acme:greeter at 0.3.0 publishes to ghcr.io/acme/wasm-components/acme/greeter:0.3.0.

Mirror ​

Postgres is copied from Docker Hub with its upstream path and tag:

sh
crane copy docker.io/library/postgres:16 \
  ghcr.io/acme/mirrors/docker-hub/library/postgres:16

The 16 tag follows the upstream on every refresh. In Artifact Registry the same image is <location>-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/mirrors-docker-hub/library/postgres:16.

Signatures ​

cosign sign ghcr.io/acme/images/shop/api@sha256:9b1e… stores the signature in images/shop/api, attached to the digest. oras copy -r moves it along with the image to another registry; a plain pull and push leaves it behind.

Cleanup ​

A scheduled job deletes pr-* and 0.0.0-pr-* versions after the age the project sets, since GitHub Container Registry has no cleanup policy. Nothing tagged 1.4.0 is deleted.

Result ​

txt
ghcr.io/acme
├── images/shop/api                     1.4.0, 1.4.0-debug, 3f2c…4e3f, latest, 1.x
├── charts/shop/api                     2.1.0, 0.0.0-sha-3f2c…4e3f
├── wasm-components/acme/greeter        0.3.0
└── mirrors/docker-hub/library/postgres 16
